content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: The senate committee has given preliminary approval to a sweeping education reform bill aimed at improving teacher training and reducing class sizes, though the measure still faces opposition.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: Supporters believe the bill will enhance the quality of education and prepare students better for the workforce.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Critics, however, warn that the proposed funding increases could strain already tight budgets and lead to job losses in other areas.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: The bill now moves to the full senate for further debate and voting.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: Teachers unions have expressed mixed reactions, with some backing the reforms and others concerned about potential layoffs.

content_blocks.text: ‘Enhance the quality of education and prepare students better for the workforce.’ — Proponents
